budgetEvidence.hardwareTimingRationale: The vertical axis advances one pixel per frame and the horizontal axis is driven by a subpixel accumulator that yields zero, one or two pixels per frame; each edge is still prepared outside VBlank and commits one bounded axis edge at a time.
budgetEvidence.productionTraceRationale: Uniform diagonal motion is a blind spot because the runtime anchors a prefetched row on a predicted camera column and a perfectly regular camera always lands on that prediction. This sample reproduces the irregular cadence samples/runner uses, where the camera drifts off the prediction between a row's preparation and its crossing and leaves the diagonal corner tile covered by neither edge. On the pre-fix runtime at commit a4b2ba4aa377a96adcd7a4b6f8f6175a4b58b844 this window reports 127 background mismatches; the fixed runtime reports zero.
